title: Roasted Brussel Sprouts with Sriracha Aioli

items.item: fresh brussel sprouts, trimmed and halved

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Place the brussels sprouts on a rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with the olive oil and 1 teaspoon of the chili sauce; sprinkle with ¼ teaspoon of the salt and ¼ teaspoon of the pepper. Toss to coat.
Roast the brussels sprouts until crispy, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the mayonnaise, lime juice, the remaining 1-3 teaspoons of chili sauce, ¼ teaspoon of salt, and ¼ teaspoon of pepper to make the aioli.
Drizzle the lemon juice over the brussels sprouts and serve with the aioli.
